name: MongoDB Atlas (M0 Free Cluster)

free_tier.notes: Hard limit; cannot be exceeded without upgrading
Also must stay under 100% query utilization over any 5-minute period

free_tier.limit: 10 GB in / 10 GB out per 7-day rolling period

free_tier.notes: Shared RAM/vCPU, 3-node replica set, no sharding

notes: Perpetual free tier ("Free forever" per official pricing page), not a trial or credits. Cluster auto-pauses after 30 days with zero connections. No backups (use mongodump), no Performance Advisor, no VPC peering/private endpoints, no server-side JavaScript, aggregation limited to 50 stages, MongoDB version fixed (currently 8.0, auto-upgraded). Signup form has no credit card field (verified 2026-07-03).
